## Vegepygmy Worker (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
 N Small plant (fungus)  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +9  

**Defense**

 **AC** 16, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +3 natural, +1 size)  
 **hp** 27 (3d8 plus 3)  
 **Fort** +3, **Ref** +3, **Will** +1  
 **DR** 5/bludgeoning or slashing; **Immune** electricity, plant traits  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** 2 claws +3 (1d3) or spear +3 (1d6/x3)  
 **Ranged** spear +5 (1d6/x3)  

**Tactics**

 Vegepygmies attack with claws or weapons, usually either a longspear or club. They prefer to ambush opponents, using their coloration to blend with their natural surroundings.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 11, **Dex** 14, **Con** 11, **Int** 8, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 10  
 **Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +1; **CMD** 13  
 **Feats** Skill Focus (Perception), Toughness  
 **Skills** Perception +9, Stealth +10 (+18 in forested or swampy areas); **Racial Modifiers** +4 Stealth (+12 in forested or swampy areas)  
 **Gear** spear  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any underground  
 **Organization** gang (2-5) or work force (4-7)  
 **Treasure** standard
